name: ANI Public-Condition Interpretation and Evidence Gate
scope: Province/ecosystem-level environmental planning context. Does not alter the trained XGBoost yield prediction.
summary: For Nueva Ecija (Rainfed, Rain-dependent), the 2026-10-14 to 2026-10-23 outlook shows 14.1 mm Open-Meteo rainfall, 12.02 mm CHIRPS3-GEFS rainfall, 4 rainy days, 26.96 C mean temperature, 84.34% mean RH, 27.4 km/h maximum gust, and 0.248 m3/m3 surface soil moisture. Rainfall-source agreement is strong (15.9% relative difference). Temperature is broadly compatible with rice development, but the available variables are not sufficient to issue a validated planting-date recommendation.

signals.value: Open-Meteo 14.10 mm vs CHIRPS3-GEFS 12.02 mm (15.9% relative difference)
signals.interpretation: The two independent rainfall totals are reasonably close.
signals.basis: ANI Stage 4 source-consistency rule; not an agronomic suitability threshold.

signals.interpretation: Mean temperature is close to the broad optimum region used in rice crop-development literature.
signals.basis: Broad rice development context from IRRI/ORYZA literature (cardinal temperatures approximately 8 C base, 30 C optimum, 42 C maximum).

signals.value: 14.10 mm Open-Meteo; 12.02 mm CHIRPS3-GEFS over the forecast window
signals.interpretation: Rainfall is recorded as a planning signal, but ANI does not convert this total into a rainfed planting recommendation without effective-rainfall and crop-water-balance calibration.
signals.basis: FAO crop-water guidance requires crop stage, evapotranspiration, effective rainfall, and water-balance context rather than a rainfall-total-only rule.

signals.interpretation: Rainfall frequency is retained for interpretation. No favorable/unfavorable threshold is applied until a local Nueva Ecija planting rule is validated.
signals.basis: No validated ANI rainfed planting threshold has been established yet.

signals.interpretation: Volumetric soil moisture cannot be labeled adequate or inadequate without soil texture and locally relevant field-capacity / wilting-point information.
signals.basis: Soil-moisture thresholds are soil-specific; a universal cutoff would be misleading.

signals.interpretation: Humidity is preserved as environmental context. ANI does not infer disease risk from RH alone.
signals.basis: Disease-pressure assessment would require crop stage, duration/leaf wetness, pathogen context, and validation.

signals.interpretation: Wind is retained as context. No lodging or damage threshold is applied without crop-stage and variety information.
signals.basis: Wind vulnerability is stage- and variety-dependent.

required_before_validated_planting_recom: Locally validated rainfed planting decision thresholds for Nueva Ecija
Crop establishment method and intended planting/transplanting stage
Reference evapotranspiration (ETo) or a defensible water-balance estimate
Effective rainfall rather than rainfall total alone
Soil texture plus field capacity / wilting point or equivalent local soil-water calibration
Validation of the rule against historical planting outcomes or expert agronomic review
integration_note: Keep this Stage 4 report separate from the XGBoost feature vector. The current ANI model was trained on lagged quarterly agricultural/weather features, not on these forward 10-day conditions.
